description: This file defines a React functional component called 'Column' which is part of a task management UI. It renders a column with a header, icon, task count, and a list of task cards, supporting drag-and-drop functionality via the 'react-beautiful-dnd' (or similar) library. It also includes conditional rendering for empty states and icon selection based on the column title.

methods.name: Column
methods.description: React functional component that renders a task column with header, icon, task count, and task cards with drag-and-drop support.

methods.name: getColumnIcon
methods.description: Helper function to select an icon SVG based on the column title, indicating its status (backlog, progress, done, etc.).
